_comment: Machine-readable form of README 'Release gate'. tests/acceptance.py evaluates every item from files under evidence/. Missing or malformed evidence is not a pass. Agents never create or edit evidence/ (see AGENTS.md).

items.title: 每个声明的工作流端到端成功率 ≥ 95%
items.readme: Require at least 95% successful end-to-end operations in each declared workflow ... on a preregistered held-out scenario matrix
items.min_rate_basis: Wilson 95% lower bound, not the point estimate
items.min_slice_basis: each by_scenario / by_environment slice needs this many runs and must reach min_rate on its point estimate
items.next_step: 在 tests/ 下做一个可重复的端到端场景矩阵 runner（事先登记矩阵、固定种子、记录环境、耗时和置信区间），输出这份证据的 JSON 格式。判定用成功率的 95% 置信下界，所以每个工作流需要足够多的次数（全部成功也至少 73 次，即 min_attempts）。只用合成账号和本地或隔离网络。

items.title: 关键失败为零：受保护流量无直连或错路出口，对照工作负载不中断
items.readme: zero observed direct or wrong-route egress for protected flows ... Verify at an independent network observer; app logs alone do not count.
items.scenarios_basis: every G3 case, normal and inject_*; MCP cases only skipped when met G1 evidence marks MCP unsupported
items.next_step: 做一个独立于 Hachi 进程的网络观察器（例如在隔离网关或独立 VM 上抓包统计），让故障矩阵的结果由观察器而不是应用日志给出。

items.title: 初始实验用例全部通过
items.readme: Initial lab cases: TCP/TLS streams including reconnect and token-like refresh, system/browser redirect and loopback callback, DNS IPv4/IPv6/UDP, MCP stdio child isolation and remote streaming. Inject route change, tunnel/core loss, already-open flows, sleep/wake, interface switch, update and extension disable/restart.
items.next_step: 把 tests/lab.py 的回环夹具扩展成用例库，每个用例一个可单独运行的场景，结果写成这份证据的 JSON 格式。先做不需要 Network Extension 的用例。inject_* 用例只验证 Hachi 在本地夹具上能否检测到变化并提醒用户，不实现流量重定向或强制出口。

items.title: 迁移证据：夹具客户端和真实签名客户端走同一套系统执行机制
items.readme: Transfer evidence: exercise the same final OS enforcement mechanism across fixture clients and real signed client binaries in isolated homes.
items.next_step: 先在隔离 home 里做无凭据运行，核对进程和签名身份、辅助进程、重定向和 DNS 行为，差距写进 docs/ 下的文档并在证据里引用。不使用任何真实平台账号。

items.title: 签名 Network Extension 可行性，以及扩展不可用时的独立测试
items.readme: Key blocker: signed Network Extension feasibility and independent test of behavior when extensions are unavailable.
items.next_step: 写一份可行性文档：需要的签名和 entitlement、没有开发者账号时能做到哪一步、扩展不可用时应用应该怎样提醒用户。需要真实签名的部分由维护者完成。
